label: Instance infra status
description: Read the state of one instance's copy of a `@per_instance` infra node: `none` (never started, or terminated), provisioning, running, flaky, stopping, stopped, terminating or failed. A start or stop just requested already reads provisioning or stopping, as `weft status` does.

inputs.name: node
inputs.description: The `@per_instance` infra node, named as the program writes it (`bridge`, `work.bridge` inside a group, or `one.bridge` inside an included file).

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance id your program gives it (`user-42`).

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: The copy's state, `none` when there is none.

outputs.name: running
outputs.description: True when the copy is answering now.

then.message: InstanceInfraStatus '{id}' names {names} in `node`, which is no infra node of this program marked `@per_instance`. Name one the way the program writes it (`bridge`, `work.bridge` inside a group, or `one.bridge` inside an included file).
